主要内容: The document titled 's341216k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, dated March 5, 2012. The filing includes information about the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, which are linked to various equity indices such as the S&P 500® Index, TOPIX® Index, and MSCI EAFE Index. The notes were issued on or following the date of the report, with principal amounts totaling $5,640,000, $2,185,000, and $1,535,000 respectively. The filing also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian and New York law. The report is incorporated by reference into the Bank’s Registration Statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806).
